Basic mode: a child who knows phones can get around it. Device Owner closes those ways.
See how a child gets around it

In basic mode the child can still:
• Start in Safe Mode: every block is gone for a while.
• Turn off accessibility, or the phone turns it off: apps are no longer blocked.
• Factory reset the phone, change the clock.

Device Owner closes these ways at system level. A blocked app stays locked; it does not open first and get pushed out.

Before you upgrade:
• App accounts (Zalo, Facebook, Telegram...) are kept: KidGuard turns those apps off for a moment and the phone restarts once during setup.
• Phone accounts (Google, Xiaomi, Samsung, Oppo...) must be removed first in Settings → Accounts. Sign in again after setup; online data stays.
• Needs Android 11 or later and Wi-Fi, or a computer.
